overall_visual_style: A warm, halftone-textured flat-illustration style throughout, carried directly from the source app's recurring bald cartoon figure and muted amber/teal/orange palette; every shot crops out app chrome, the status bar, and the unrelated cricket-score banner so only the illustrated story world and narration-timed text overlays remain. Camera language stays slow, deliberate, and hushed -- soft push-ins, gentle horizontal pans, and unhurried pull-backs -- mirroring the narrator's calm, contemplative pacing, with motion intensity rising only slightly on the two human-scale "practice" scenes to underline physical, earned effort versus the stillness of realization.
